name: Aarti Industries Ltd
about: Aarti Industries Ltd, the flagship company of the Aarti group, manufacturing organic and inorganic chemicals at its major facilities in Vapi, Jhagadia, Dahej and Kutch, in Gujarat and in Tarapur in Maharashtra. The company has a strong market position in the NCB-based specialty chemicals segment.[1]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1] The company’s key product value chains include Nitro Chloro Benzenes (NCB), Di-Chloro Benzenes (DCB), Phenylenediamines (PDA), Nitro Toluene derivatives, and Sulphuric Acid & downstream products, with a portfolio of over 100 products.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 2.79 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 7.12% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Dividend payout has been low at 9.44% of profits over last 3 years
Debtor days have increased from 50.1 to 61.8 days.
